Mirror the pattern already used in tests/src/org.springframework/spring-context/6.0.0 and tests/src/org.springframework/spring-aop/6.0.0: add a PredefinedCglibProxyClassesGenerator (JavaExec) that exercises the code paths creating AspectJTransactionManagementConfiguration$$SpringCGLIB$$0 and SpringConfiguredConfiguration$$SpringCGLIB$$0 (via aspectjModeRegistersCacheTransactionAndAsyncInfrastructureAspects()/springConfiguredRegistersTheSingletonBeanConfigurerAspect()-style setup), dumping .class bytes into the test classes dir via the cglib.debugLocation system property; wire a generatePredefinedCglibProxyClasses task that nativeTestCompile/nativeTraceImage depend on. Set spring.objenesis.ignore=true as a systemProperty on Test tasks and as a nativeTest runtimeArgs / graalvmNative.binaries.test buildArgs entry. Register the generated proxy classes in reachability-metadata.json as reflection entries with condition.typeReached = org.springframework.cglib.proxy.Enhancer, following the exact structure in spring-context/6.0.0's reachability-metadata.json.

input_evidence.summary: #9399 [Automation] native-image run fails for org.springframework:spring-aspects:6.0.0; label=fails-native-image-run; body_chars=8015

risks: The exact CGLIB proxy class names/count depend on which internal @Configuration classes get enhanced for spring-aspects' AnnotationTransactionAspect/AnnotationCacheAspect/AnnotationAsyncExecutionAspect/AnnotationBeanConfigurerAspect wiring; must be verified locally via reproduction rather than assumed from the spring-context precedent.
Only 2 of 8 tests failed in this reproduction; other tests may reveal further CGLIB proxy classes once the metadata/test suite is regenerated against 6.0.0 rather than reused from 5.3.31.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: spring-aspects 6.0.0 CGLIB-enhances Spring's internal @EnableTransactionManagement/@EnableSpringConfigured configuration classes (AspectJTransactionManagementConfiguration, SpringConfiguredConfiguration), which fails native-image with 'Classes cannot be defined at runtime'; this repo already has a working predefined-CGLIB-class workaround for the same pattern in spring-context/spring-aop 6.0.0, so it needs porting rather than new dependencies.
